USD = 175800 / 6.8228, rounded to nearest dollar. Series: https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/DEXCHUS.

Result rounded to nearest USD. China list price converted for Compare; not a US MSRP. Underlying CNY remains tier S aggregator.
